description: This file is a shell script providing utility functions for crash dump uploads in a network device environment. It includes functions to obtain system info such as CPU core type, interface name, MAC address, network status, and system model, as well as utility functions like file timestamp retrieval and checksum calculation.

methods.name: getLastModifiedTimeOfFile
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of a specified file in a formatted string.

methods.name: get_core_value
methods.description: Determines and returns the CPU core type (ATOM or ARM) based on system information.

methods.name: get_interface_value
methods.description: Determines and returns the network interface name based on device type and CPU core.

methods.name: get_mac_address
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for the specified network interface, with different methods based on CPU core type.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the device's primary network interface.

methods.name: network_commn_status
methods.description: Checks and reports the network connection status and IP address depending on CPU core type.

methods.name: getSHA1
methods.description: Calculates and returns the SHA1 checksum of a given file.

methods.name: Uptime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: get_model_value
methods.description: Determines the device model name based on CPU core type and version files.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the device's model identifier from version files.
